article.title: Is the best mathematician in the world an AI model?
article.author: Editor
article.content: ON October 6, 2026, OpenAI put out a document announcing new solutions to longstanding mathematical problems proved by an Artificial Intelligence (AI) model. The post Is the best mathematician in the world an AI model? appeared first on MR Online .
